processor_evidence.finding: Both Duel.Summon and Duel.SpecialSummonRule overwrite one core.summon_reserved slot while a chain is active.
processor_evidence.release: ../gemini-core-reference/processor.cpp lines 4557 and 4584 dispatch the slot after a link or at chain end.

competing_tests: Installed Oceanica Normal follow-up displaces Bobbie for either original mode. The rule-Special candidate also displaces Bobbie in all four original/follow-up combinations. Candidate passes isolated Link 1 Normal and Special negation and both Link 2 order controls.

success_listener_probe.link_1: All four Normal/Special combinations preserve both summons.
success_listener_probe.link_2: All four preserve both summons, but the second occurs after the lower link starts.
success_listener_probe.additional_gap: The prototype still needs handling when Bobbie’s summon is negated or never happens.
